title: API rate limits
heading: API rate limits
text:
# API rate limits

_Section: Developers_ · _Last updated: 2026-02-09_

Rate limits apply per account across all API keys.

- Starter: 100 requests per minute.
- Pro: 1,000 requests per minute.
- Scale: 5,000 requests per minute.
- Enterprise limits are agreed in the contract.

Requests above the limit return HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header. Use exponential backoff and idempotency keys when retrying.

Plans formerly called Basic and Business are now Starter and Scale.

title: Creating a charge
heading: Creating a charge
text:
# Creating a charge

_Section: Developers_

Use the Charges API to take a payment.

1. Send `POST /v1/charges` with `amount`, `currency` and `source`.
2. Read the `status` field of the response.
3. Use `POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund` to refund.

Charges are the primary way to accept payments.

Subscriptions: the maximum trial length rises from 14 to 30 days.

title: Product changelog
heading: Update 2025-10-06

Product changelog update (2025-10-06):
Subscriptions: proration is now calculated per day (previously on a 30-day month).

title: Product changelog

API keys: the grace period when rolling a key is shortened from 48 to 24 hours.

title: Product changelog

Invoices: the attachment size limit rises from 5 MB to 10 MB.

title: Product changelog
heading: Update 2025-08-01

Disputes: the evidence deadline is shortened from 10 to 7 days. The dispute fee drops from €20 to €15.

title: Product changelog
heading: Update 2025-07-01
text:
Product changelog update (2025-07-01):
Currencies: the conversion fee drops from 1.5% to 1.0%.

title: Product changelog
heading: Update 2025-06-17
text:
Product changelog update (2025-06-17):
Smart Retries: failed subscription payments are retried 4 times over 14 days (previously 3 times over 7 days).

title: Product changelog
heading: Update 2025-06-01
text:
Product changelog update (2025-06-01):
Security: two-factor authentication becomes mandatory for team admins. SSO is limited to Scale and Enterprise (previously Pro and above).

title: Product changelog
heading: Update 2025-05-06
text:
Product changelog update (2025-05-06):
Coupons: stacking is removed. One coupon per subscription.

title: Product changelog
heading: Update 2025-03-01
text:
Product changelog update (2025-03-01):
Plans: Basic is renamed Starter and Business is renamed Scale. Rate limits rise: Starter 60 to 100, Pro 500 to 1,000, Scale 2,000 to 5,000 requests per minute. Billing Portal is renamed Customer Portal, Auto Recovery is renamed Smart Retries, and the Charges API is renamed Payments API.

title: Product changelog
heading: Update 2025-01-15
text:
Product changelog update (2025-01-15):
API: `/v1/charges` is deprecated. Sunset date: 15 January 2026. Use `/v2/payments`.

title: Product changelog
heading: Update 2024-10-14
text:
Product changelog update (2024-10-14):
Payouts: instant payouts launch for Pro and Business at 1% (minimum €0.50).

title: Product changelog
heading: Update 2024-07-01
text:
Product changelog update (2024-07-01):
Refunds: processing fees are no longer returned when a payment is refunded.

title: Product changelog
heading: Update 2024-06-30
text:
Product changelog update (2024-06-30):
Webhooks: SHA-1 signatures and the legacy header are removed. All signatures use HMAC-SHA256.

title: Product changelog
heading: Update 2024-03-11
text:
Product changelog update (2024-03-11):
Refunds: the card refund window is extended from 90 to 180 days. Partial refunds are no longer limited to 3 per payment and can be issued from the Dashboard.

title: Product changelog
heading: Update 2023-09-12
text:
Product changelog update (2023-09-12):
Webhooks: the signature header is renamed from `X-Paperkite-Sig` to `Paperkite-Signature`. The old header is sent in parallel until 30 June 2024.

title: Handling disputes

text:
# Handling disputes

_Section: Payments_ · _Last updated: 2025-08-12_

A dispute opens when a cardholder challenges a payment with their bank.

- You have 7 days from the dispute notification to submit evidence.
- Each dispute carries a €15 fee, returned if you win.
- Useful evidence: proof of delivery, customer communication, signed terms.
- Submit evidence under **Payments > Disputes**.

title: Smart Retries for failed subscription payments
heading: Smart Retries for failed subscription payments
text:
# Smart Retries for failed subscription payments

_Section: Billing_ · _Last updated: 2025-06-24_

When a subscription payment fails, Smart Retries tries again at the best time for the card.

- Paperkite retries 4 times over 14 days.
- Customers receive emails on days 1, 5 and 12.
- After the final failure the subscription is marked unpaid or canceled, as you configure.

title: Payments API
heading: Payments API
text:
# Payments API

_Section: Developers_ · _Last updated: 2026-02-17_

Create a payment with `POST /v2/payments`.

- Amounts are integers in minor units, for example 2500 for €25.00.
- Send an `Idempotency-Key` header. Keys are valid for 24 hours.
- A payment that needs customer action has the status `requires_action`.
- Use `GET /v2/payments/{id}` to read a payment.

title: Issuing refunds

text:
# Issuing refunds

_Section: Payments_ · _Last updated: 2026-03-04_

You can refund any successful payment in full or in part, from the Dashboard or through the API.

title: Issuing refunds
heading: Partial refunds
text:
## Partial refunds

1. Open **Payments** and select the payment.
2. Choose **Refund**, then **Partial refund**.
3. Enter the amount and an optional reason.
4. Confirm. The refund is created immediately.

You can issue several partial refunds against the same payment until the refunded total equals the original amount. Through the API, call `POST /v2/refunds` with the `payment_id` and an `amount` in minor units.

title: Issuing refunds
heading: Refund windows
text:
## Refund windows

- Card payments can be refunded for 180 days after the payment date.
- SEPA Direct Debit and ACH Debit payments can be refunded for 60 days.
- All other payment methods follow the card window.
- Refunds reach the customer's statement in 5–10 business days.

title: Issuing refunds
heading: Fees
text:
## Fees

Since 1 July 2024 the processing fee charged on the original payment is not returned when you refund it.

# Proration on plan changes

_Section: Billing_ · _Last updated: 2025-10-14_

When a customer changes plan mid-cycle, Paperkite prorates the difference per day.

- Upgrades: the difference for the remaining days is invoiced immediately.
- Downgrades: the unused amount is credited to the next invoice.

_Section: Billing_ · _Last updated: 2026-01-20_

- A subscription can be paused for up to 90 days.
- Cancellations take effect at the end of the billing period by default; you can also cancel immediately.

title: VAT for EU customers
heading: VAT for EU customers
text:
# VAT for EU customers

_Section: Billing_ · _Last updated: 2025-12-02_

Paperkite calculates VAT on each invoice line, including prorated lines.

- The rate is that of the customer's billing country, at the invoice date.
- VAT is applied to the net, prorated amount.
- Business customers with a valid VAT ID (checked against VIES) are invoiced at 0% under the reverse charge.
- One Stop Shop (OSS) reporting is supported.

title: Webhooks troubleshooting FAQ
heading: Why did my endpoint stop receiving events?
text:
## Why did my endpoint stop receiving events?

Paperkite retries failed deliveries up to 5 times over 12 hours. After that the event is marked as failed and you can replay it from the Dashboard.

title: Webhooks guide
heading: Webhooks guide
text:
# Webhooks guide

_Section: Developers_ · _Last updated: 2025-08-18_

Paperkite sends events to your endpoint as signed HTTPS POST requests.

- The signature is in the `Paperkite-Signature` header, computed with HMAC-SHA256.
- Reject requests whose timestamp is more than 5 minutes old.
- Respond with any 2xx status within 10 seconds.
- Failed deliveries are retried up to 8 times over 24 hours with exponential backoff.

# Verifying webhook signatures

_Section: Developers_

- The signature is in the `X-Paperkite-Sig` header, computed with HMAC-SHA1.
- Reject requests older than 10 minutes.
